items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: Because a lot of time I used to go to the Lyrics Theater when the old Professor Joe Robichow was playing at the old Lyrics Theater.

ctx.x: Well, after I'd get up in the daytime, wash up and eat, I'd sit down and practice with a little 10 cents gazoot. Oh, yeah. Yeah. And that's how I learned myself how to set my time and everything from what I've heard, Baby Dots and Henry Martin and Red Happy used to do. Yeah. Because a lot of time I used to go to the Lyrics Theater when the old Professor Joe Robichow was playing at the old Lyrics Theater. Yeah. items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: Well I never heard him play with no other band outside of Old Man Joe Robichaux.

ctx.x: No. Any of the dance orchestra that you ever heard him with?
Well I never heard him play with no other band outside of Old Man Joe Robichaux.
